| Attribute           | Applied when               | Purpose                                      |

| data-slot="title"   | Always                     | Stable title slot selector.                  |
| data-slot="content" | Always                     | Stable content slot selector.                |
| data-slot="icon"    | `icon` prop is provided    | Stable icon slot selector.                   |

| data-open           | Item is expanded           | Styling hook for the open/active state.      |
| data-type           | Always                     | Inherited from parent Accordion `type` prop. |
